destination.name: Vanua Levu
destination.tagline: Fiji's northern island of yacht anchorages, hot springs and rainforest walks
destination.description: Vanua Levu is a large island in Fiji's north. Savusavu, on its south coast, is the main tourist base, with a yacht club, diving and geothermal hot springs. Waisali Rainforest Reserve, a community-run reserve a 30-minute drive northwest of Savusavu, has walking trails, rare birds and endemic frogs. Labasa, the island's largest town, sits on a river delta in the north and has a large Indo-Fijian community.
whyVisit: Sail and dive from a harbour town

goodToKnow.title: Waisali entry is cheap
goodToKnow.detail: Waisali Rainforest Reserve charges about FJD 3 for adults and FJD 1 for children, and is a 30-minute drive northwest of Savusavu.

goodToKnow.title: Two towns, two bases
goodToKnow.detail: Savusavu is the main tourist base for diving and yachting, while Labasa is the largest town. Buses link the two.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Come in {months}, the cooler months, for diving, sailing and rainforest walks. Cyclones can occur Nov to Apr.

vanua-levu-1.bio: Town on Vanua Levu's south coast with a yacht club at the old Copra Shed, diving and geothermal hot springs.

vanua-levu-2.bio: Rainforest reserve northwest of Savusavu, co-managed by its community, with walking trails, rare birds and endemic frogs.

vanua-levu-3.bio: Vanua Levu's largest town, set on a river delta, with a farmers' market and a main street of Indo-Fijian shops and curry houses.
